whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a lockfile that records no pod checksums.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a lockfile that records no pod checksums.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm Podfile.lock no longer carries a lockfile that records no pod checksums.
